notes:
Offline downloads fixed + GitHub updates.

- A video that stopped downloading mid-way is no longer treated as a finished download. Completeness is now proven by a recorded byte count, so a truncated file is re-fetched instead of failing at playback.
- Downloaded lessons now open from the Downloads screen with no connection at all.
- App updates now come from GitHub instead of the server, so a new version can be installed from the phone with no cable.

Arabic notes:
- إصلاح الفيديوهات التي لا تعمل بدون واي فاي.
- إصلاح تحميل التحديثات من GitHub بدون كيبل.
